intro.text: You wake up in a strange glowing room. Three mysterious doors stand before you.

dragon.text: You open the red door. Heat races through your body as scales spread across your skin, your frame expands, and powerful wings unfold behind you. You have transformed into a dragon.

wizard.text: You open the blue door. Blue light coils around your arms as your clothes reshape into layered robes and a carved staff appears in your hand. You have transformed into a wizard.

vampire.text: You open the green door. A chill slips through your body as your skin pales, your senses sharpen, and your teeth lengthen into fangs. You have transformed into a vampire.

dragonCrossroads.text: You spread your wings and leap into the sky. A vast mountain range stretches before you. Where will Drakon go?

dragonMountains.text: Drakon beats his enormous wings and climbs toward the frozen mountain peaks. Snow whips across his scales as he spots a ruined stone fortress built into the cliffside. A deep roar echoes from somewhere inside.

dragonFortress.text: Drakon lands on the ancient stone fortress. Broken towers surround him. A gigantic golden egg rests on a pedestal in the center of the ruins.

dragonEgg.text: As Drakon approaches, the enormous golden egg begins to glow. Tiny cracks spread across its shell. Something inside taps back when he touches it.

dragonHatch.text: The golden shell cracks apart in a burst of warm light. A tiny dragon emerges, blinking up at Drakon before letting out a squeaky roar.

dragonProtectHatchling.text: Drakon curls one immense wing around the tiny hatchling. The baby chirps happily and presses against his scales. From deep within the fortress, heavy footsteps begin approaching.

dragonGuardian.text: The massive stone doors burst open. An ancient silver dragon steps into the chamber, studying Drakon and the hatchling with glowing blue eyes.

dragonPeace.text: The ancient guardian lowers his head. He explains that the hatchling is the last heir of a vanished dragon clan and asks whether Drakon will protect it.

dragonBlessing.text: The guardian presses one claw to Drakon's brow. Silver light spreads across his scales, granting him the power to shield the hatchling from harm.

choices.text: 🌤️ Leave the fortress with the hatchling

dragonHatchlingLore.text: The guardian reveals that the hatchling can awaken ancient dragon roads hidden across the world. Whoever raises it may decide whether dragons return in peace or conquest.

dragonFight.text: Drakon lunges. The silver guardian meets him with a thunderous clash of claws and wings, shaking dust from the ruined ceiling.

dragonFightFire.text: Drakon unleashes a torrent of flame. The guardian withstands it, but the ancient pillars crack and the chamber begins collapsing.

dragonFightDefend.text: Drakon plants himself between the guardian and the hatchling. Seeing that his first instinct is protection, the guardian slowly lowers his claws.

dragonShell.text: The shattered shell glitters with ancient runes. One fragment pulses with magical energy while another contains a faded map.

dragonRune.text: The rune burns with cold light. Images flash through Drakon's mind: hidden dragon sanctuaries, sealed gates, and a crown made of starlight.

choices.text: 👑 Follow the vision of the crown
🗺️ Compare the vision to the map

dragonMap.text: The faded map reveals three marked locations: a forest shrine, a royal vault, and a volcanic gate beneath the mountains.

dragonCarryEgg.text: Drakon carefully lifts the golden egg. It is surprisingly warm. As he carries it away, the fortress begins to shake violently.

dragonEscape.text: Drakon launches through a collapsing archway with the hatchling held safely against his chest. Behind him, the fortress disappears beneath a cloud of snow and stone.

dragonMountainRefuge.text: Drakon discovers a warm cavern high above the clouds. The hatchling curls beside him, safe for the moment.

choices.text: 🌅 Begin a new life as its guardian

dragonRuins.text: Drakon's call echoes through the fortress. Ancient dragon statues turn their stone heads toward him, and a hidden stairway opens beneath the pedestal.

dragonRival.text: A scarred red dragon rises from behind the ridge and answers Drakon's roar. It claims the mountains as its territory.

dragonRivalFight.text: The two dragons collide above the peaks. Drakon gains the upper hand, forcing the rival toward a narrow ledge.

dragonRivalAlliance.text: The rival agrees to share the mountain skies. Together, the two dragons uncover routes to places neither could safely reach alone.

dragonForest.text: Drakon glides beneath the treetops into an ancient forest glowing with blue mushrooms. A stone shrine stands beside a mirror-still lake.

dragonForestShrine.text: Inside the shrine, carvings depict dragons taking human form. A crystal altar hums with transformation magic.

dragonHumanForm.text: Magic folds Drakon's enormous body inward. Wings, claws, and scales vanish until he stands in a tall human-like form with golden eyes and faint scale patterns along his arms.

dragonRestoreForm.text: Drakon releases the shrine's magic. His body expands, scales return, and his immense wings unfold once more.

dragonForestRecords.text: The records describe a lost starlight crown capable of stabilizing any transformation and preserving memories between forms.

dragonLake.text: The lake water glows as Drakon drinks. For a moment, he sees every form he might someday become reflected across the surface.

dragonKingdom.text: Drakon circles above a walled kingdom. Bells ring and soldiers rush onto the battlements as citizens flee the streets below.

dragonKingdomAttack.text: Flames race across the outer defenses. The kingdom's royal mages raise a shimmering barrier while a hidden vault begins glowing beneath the castle.

dragonKingdomAudience.text: Drakon lands beyond the city gates. The queen approaches under a white banner and offers information about an ancient dragon crown in exchange for peace.

dragonKingdomDisguise.text: In human form, Drakon enters the city unnoticed. Rumors lead him to a locked royal vault beneath the castle.

choices.text: 🐉 Restore dragon form outside the city

dragonRoyalVault.text: Inside the royal vault, Drakon finds a shard of starlight suspended above a black stone pedestal. It resonates with the rune from the egg shell.

dragonVolcanicGate.text: Deep beneath the mountains, a circular gate of black stone stands over a river of lava. The hatchling's presence makes its runes awaken.

dragonStarCrown.text: The scattered clues unite in a burst of starlight. A radiant crown forms above Drakon's head, granting him control over his transformation and the power to return to any path he has discovered.

choices.text: 🌟 Use the crown to protect the realm
👑 Use the crown to rule the realm
🔄 Use the crown to choose a new transformation

dragonGoodEnding.text: Drakon chooses protection over conquest. In time, dragons return to the world under his watch, and the hatchling grows beside him as the first symbol of a peaceful new age.

dragonDarkEnding.text: Drakon claims power without restraint. Kingdoms bow, rival dragons scatter, and his name becomes a warning carried across the skies.
